description: Debezium row of inventory.customers -> customer document (column names kept, plus full_name and status label)

script.description: full_name = first + last (display and phrase matching); registered_at: MicroTimestamp -> ISO-8601
script.source: List parts = new ArrayList(); if (ctx.first_name != null) { parts.add(ctx.first_name); } if (ctx.last_name != null) { parts.add(ctx.last_name); } ctx.full_name = parts.isEmpty() ? null : String.join(' ', parts); if (ctx.registered_at instanceof Number) { ctx.registered_at = Instant.EPOCH.plus(((Number) ctx.registered_at).longValue(), ChronoUnit.MICROS).toString(); }

script.description: Fixed list: status code -> label of the catalog; an unknown code becomes UNKNOWN, never the nearest label. status_code keeps the integer
script.source: Map labels = ['0': 'PENDING', '1': 'ACTIVE', '2': 'SUSPENDED', '3': 'CLOSED']; if (ctx.status instanceof Number) { ctx.status_code = ((Number) ctx.status).intValue(); ctx.status = labels.getOrDefault(String.valueOf(ctx.status_code), 'UNKNOWN'); }
